anims.name: STRETCH
anims.story: After your reference photos: the front paws reach out along the ground while the chest sinks almost to the floor and the rump stays up on straight hind legs, tail raised. The eyes close as it sinks into the bow, and at the bottom the head tips up into a slow yawn with the ears flattened. Then it rocks forward onto its front legs, stretches each hind leg out behind in turn, and walks back to standing.
anims.about: 5.6 s, plays once, one key per tick. Uses three added groups: chest_shell and torso_shell (the torso widens slightly to hide the upper arms) and lower_jaw (only the lower jaw opens). The lowest cheek-fur spike on each side is its own piece (cheek_spike_l, cheek_spike_r) and hides while it would poke through a front leg.

anims.name: MARK
anims.story: Marking a tree: the tiger rears up against the trunk, scratches down the bark three times with alternating paws, then pushes off and lands back on all fours. The birch logs are shown only for this one, at the distance the animation was built for.
anims.about: 6.6 s, plays once. Made in this chat. The tree isn't part of the model; it's only in the preview.

anims.name: SPRAY
anims.story: Spray-marking a tree: standing with its rump to the trunk, the tiger eases its weight back toward the bark and dips its front so the hindquarters lift, raises its tail straight up, and holds it there quivering while it sprays backward onto the tree, glancing to the side. Then the tail comes down and it settles back to standing. All four paws stay planted.
anims.about: 4.4 s, plays once, starts and ends standing. The tree (birch logs, with your new log top) is only in the preview, placed where the animation was built for: the trunk's face 27.3 px behind the tiger's origin (the tail passes through the trunk as it rises).

anims.name: CHEEK_RUB
anims.story: Cheek-rubbing a tree to leave its scent, the way house cats rub against a chair leg: the tiger leans its whole body toward the trunk, turns its head into it and tips it so the side of the face meets the bark, then strokes its cheek along it three times, the chin lifting and the ears flattening on each push, eyes closed. The tail swishes slowly. Then it straightens up. All four paws stay planted.
anims.about: 5.6 s, plays once, starts and ends standing. The tree is only in the preview: its left face 11.25 px to the tiger's right, beside the head. The cheek fur presses into the bark on each stroke. Face (swapped by your mod): the sleep face, eyes shut, from 0.85 to 4.6 s. The tail's second part isn't moved.

anims.name: REST_GROOM
anims.story: Grooming while lying down: from the REST pose the tiger lowers its head and licks its foreleg four times with its eyes closed, then lifts its head back to rest.
anims.about: 8 s, plays once, starts and ends in your REST pose. Made in this chat. The tongue comes out of the mouth for each lick.

anims.name: CALL
anims.story: A roaring call made with the head alone; the body, legs and tail stay still. The tiger breathes in with its head lifting a little, pulls back for a beat, then pushes its head forward and up into a long roar: the lower jaw drops open, the ears flatten back and out, and a fine tremble runs through the head while the sound carries. The mouth eases half shut, a second, shorter call follows, and the head settles back to rest.
anims.about: 4.4 s, plays once, starts and ends at rest. Keys only on head, lower_jaw, ear and ear2; the upper jaw stays fixed to the head. Face (swapped by your mod, as with STRETCH): the new tiger_roar.png while the mouth is open, 0.95 to 3.8 s. It is your open-mouth stretch face with the eyes kept open.

anims.name: GALLOP
anims.story: A rotary gallop, the run big cats use: left hind, right hind, right fore, left fore. A planted paw moves straight back under the body at one steady ground speed, so it stays put on the ground; in the air each leg swings forward on a smooth curve and folds up into the body. The body moves in just two big motions per stride: it rises as the tiger leaps off its front legs and sinks as it lands, tipping nose-up off the hind legs and nose-down onto the front ones, while the back stretches through the reach and gathers. The head rides level, the ears stay laid back, and the tail follows the body's rise and fall a beat late in one smooth swing.
anims.about: 0.6 s loop, a key every 0.025 s, catmull-rom. Planted paws move back at 100 px/s, about 6.25 blocks a second: move the mob at that speed (at 1×) and the paws won't slide. The hind legs trail far out behind after each push, like your original RUN, angled so their tops stay inside the rump. While it runs, your mod should swap to tiger_run.png: your normal texture with the top third of the front legs transparent, so that part never shows when it swings out of the chest. Every other animation keeps the normal textures. Your original RUN is kept as it was.

anims.name: WALK_NEW
anims.story: A calm big-cat walk in the lateral sequence: left hind, left fore, right hind, right fore, each a quarter-stride apart. Planted paws stay put while the body moves over them; each leg lifts, swings forward on a smooth curve and sets down softly. The body dips evenly at each hind footfall and shifts its weight gently from side to side, the head is carried a little low with a soft nod, and the tail hangs low and swings slowly a beat behind the hips.
anims.about: 1.4 s loop, one key per tick, catmull-rom. Planted paws move back at about 0.9 blocks a second at 1×; match the mob's walking speed to that and the paws won't slide. The hidden tops of the legs stay inside the body. Your original WALK is kept as it was.
